special_instructions.verbatim: (1) A/C configuration, in every sortie, is determined by the syllabus. SP always occupies the front seat, except for a ferry flight.
(2) All maneuvers that have not been practiced in the F/S will be demonstrated in the air at least once by IP, before SP is asked to execute them.

(3) SP will not fly SOLO if he/she has been graded with 59% or less in the previous flight, regardless of the Training Category. SP will continue his/her training on a Dual sortie in the Training Category in which he/she was graded “ALMOST GOOD” or “FAIL”. The SOLO will be flown in another flight of the same Training Section or in the following one, if applicable.

(4) SP will not fly SOLO, past four (4) calendar days since the last dual VFR flight that he/she flew from the front seat (the day he/her flew dual is not included) and provided that he/she has achieved at least MIF «2» in normal landing.
(5) In all missions, planning and execution will be made in such a way, so that the best A/C energy management is achieved.

(6) The following maneuvers ARE FORBIDDEN to be executed in SOLO flights: (a) All kind of STALLS. (b) SPINS (including Spin Prevention) (c) Unusual Attitudes. (d) ELP. (e) Straight in approach. (f) Slow Flight. (g) No Flap Overhead Patterns/ Landings (h) Simulated Lost Wingman Procedures.
(7) AGSM will be executed for warm-up and body preparation, in any flight that pre-planned maneuvering will load the A/C with more than 3 Gs.
(8) Special requirements will be separately annotated in the Grade-Sheet and the corresponding levels of performance will be given.

(9) In the program analysis of Training Units (“Analytical description of Section exercise”) and next to each maneuver, in parenthesis, the MINIMUM NUMBER of maneuvers that SP must practice until the end of a Training Section, appear. In case that the minimum number is not achieved SP will be granted an extra sortie or he/she will cover the required items in the next Section according to Squadron Commander’s judgment.

(10) Whenever there is no minimum number next to a maneuver in the Program Analysis, but the MIF for this maneuver is bigger in this Training Section than the previous one, then the maneuver should be practiced as much as required for the MIF to be achieved.

(11) In maneuvers where no grading is determined in the Training Section (i.e. Instrument approach in Contact), SP will be graded according to the criteria of the corresponding Training Section in which he/she currently flies, provided that the maneuver had been analyzed and briefed before flight. The maneuver will be annotated in the Grade Sheet along with the corresponding MIF. In any other case, SP will not be graded, but the maneuver will be annotated in the Grade Sheet as having been demonstrated by IP.

(1) Sortie C4101 will not be graded in the General performance (NG), except in case of an Air Sickness; in this case SP performance will be graded as “FAIR” (59%), will NOT fly an FCJ and continue at the next block.

(2) Up to “PRE-SOLO” phase, SP will be scheduled and fly maximum one (1) A/C and one (1) F/S sortie daily, apart from the instance of an aborting mission, after becoming airborne, due to adverse weather or A/C malfunction (MIC).

(3) In order to adequately monitor SPs progress in Contact Category, the listed below EVALUATIONS apply: C4590, C4790, C5090 and C5490 (FINAL CHECKRIDE). Evaluation Sorties will be executed from IP evaluators according to B.O. 3-1/ATC.
(4) Both C4790 and C4791 sorties will be flown the same day, with the same A/C.
(5) The evaluator of the C4790 will supervise and grade SP’s landing from the Contact Car.
(6) Nose -high unusual attitude recovery will initially be taught as pre-planned maneuver. After SP achieves MIF “1”, recoveries will be practiced from different attitudes without previous planning.
(7) In case that the MINIMUM NUMBER of maneuvers is not achieved at the end of the block, it must be annotated in the grade sheet and executed at the next block.
(8) ELPs will be performed daytime and under VMC conditions only.
a. SP will practice one landing with more than 750 Lbs. of fuel on board (SRC-6).
1. At the SOLO sortie, SP will perform one airport traffic pattern within the airport ATZ and one normal landing.
RESTRICTIONS: Minimum A/C fuel for the 1st SOLO is 550 lbs. (LAP 10-18 and 3-20).
SP will practice No Flaps overhead traffic pattern, as well as straight in and Landings with more than 750 LBS of fuel and. (SRC-6)

3. at the «SOLO» flight: a. SP will fly in a local area where he will practice the following, provided that he / she has achieved code MIF «2» in the previous dual contact sortie: (1) Aileron Roll. (2) Chandelle. (3) Lazy «8».
c. Any maneuver permitted for SOLO, in which he / she achieved MIF «2» at the previous dual contact sortie.
c. Any maneuver allowed for SOLO, in which he / she achieved MIF «2» at the previous dual contact sortie.

flags: PDF pages 174 (printed -166-) and 180 (printed -172-) are completely blank in the source PDF (no text, no images, no vector drawings) — verified with PyMuPDF; no Contact content is missing between C4601-02→C4790-91 and C4901-05→C5090.

Section keys follow the MIF unit labels of D:\FDMS\data\mif\t6a.json (tables contact_presolo_t6a / contact_t6a). The syllabus itself prints the generic forms C41ΧΧ, C42ΧΧ, C43ΧΧ, C44ΧΧ, C4590, C46XX, C4790–C4791, C48XX, C49XX, C5090, C51XX, C52XX, C53XX, C5490.

Combined printed lines of the form 'X - Y. (a) – (b)' (e.g. 'Chandelle - Lazy «8». (4) – (4)') were split into two maneuver entries sharing the identical verbatim string; the first number belongs to the first maneuver, the second to the second, exactly as printed.

'Power οn / ELP Stalls. (a) / (b)' split into 'Power on Stalls' (a) and 'ELP Stalls' (b); both map to the single MIF row sn 8 'Power ON / ELP Stalls'. The source prints a Greek omicron in 'οn' — preserved verbatim.

'Spin Prevention / Recovery. (a) / (b)' split into 'Spin Prevention' and 'Spin Recovery'; both map to the single MIF row sn 10 'Spin Prevention / Spin Recovery'. In C4301-03 only 'Spin Prevention. (3)' is printed (no recovery number).

Lines of the form 'X overhead traffic pattern and landing. (n)' carry ONE printed number covering both pattern and landing. Stored as a SINGLE entry whose min_number is mapped to the PATTERN MIF row (mif_sn 23 / 25 / 27 / 32); the corresponding LANDING row (24 / 26 / 28 / 33) is recorded in 'mif_sn_also' so the one printed number stays traceable from the landing row WITHOUT being counted twice. Exception: C4201-03 prints them separately ('Normal overhead traffic pattern. (12)' and 'Normal landing. (12)') — two independent entries, no mif_sn_also.
C4301-03: 'ELP and ELP landing (touch n’go). (2)' — one printed number covers two MIF rows; mapped to mif_sn 30 (ELP) with mif_sn_also [31] (ELP Landing).
C4101 (PDF 167), C4590 (PDF 172), C5090 (PDF 181) and C5490 (PDF 189) contain NO parenthetical minimum numbers — familiarization sortie and the three checkrides; maneuvers arrays intentionally empty.
C4401-03 prints 'Straight - in.' with NO number (unlike C4301-03 which prints '(1)') — not recorded, per rule 1. C4801-04 and C5101-02 print no Straight-in line at all.

'per' is 'section' for every Program Analysis number, per General Directive (9) (PDF 164): the number is the minimum SP must practice UNTIL THE END OF A TRAINING SECTION, not per sortie. No Contact line in the Program Analysis defines a per-sortie minimum.

special_instructions uses an extra scope value 'section' (with an added 'section' key) for per-section SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS / RESTRICTIONS / SOLO prerequisites (SRC-6 landing >750 lbs, 1st SOLO pattern+landing, 550 lbs fuel minimum, and the MIF «2» prerequisite for SOLO maneuvers in C4901-05 / C5201-04 / C5301-04). Consumers expecting only 'category'/'phase' can filter these out safely.

Header/table discrepancies in the source: C48XX header reads 'SORTIES/HOURS TOTAL: 4/4, 9' with 3 dual + 1 solo, C49XX header 'TOTAL: 5/6,2' with 4 dual + 1 solo, C52XX and C53XX headers 'TOTAL: 4 / 4.6' with 3 dual + 1 solo — consistent with the mission table on PDF 166. Not altered.

Typography preserved verbatim: 'Barel Roll' (sic; MIF row is 'Barrel Roll'), 'touch n’go', guillemets «8» / «S», en dash in 'Straight–in' (C4901-05) vs hyphen elsewhere, and missing final periods in 'TP Stalls (2)' (C4801-04), 'Flaps T/O overhead traffic pattern and landing (3)' (C4601-02) and '(1)' (C4790-91), 'Straight-In (1)' (C5201-04).
Section names as printed in the syllabus differ slightly from the MIF row names; mif_row values are the MIF table row names, name values are the syllabus wording.

special_instructions selection criterion: ALL of GENERAL DIRECTIVES (1)-(11) (PDF 163-164) and ALL of CONTACT CATEGORY SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS (1)-(8) (PDF 165) are recorded verbatim, numeric or not, plus every per-section SPECIAL REQUIREMENT / RESTRICTION / SOLO prerequisite that carries a measurable value. 'numbers' is {} for the purely qualitative ones.

The MIF «2» prerequisite for practicing maneuvers on the SOLO sortie is printed three times and all three are recorded: PDF 179 (C49XX, item 3.a — Aileron Roll / Chandelle / Lazy «8»), PDF 186 (C52XX, item 3.c) and PDF 188 (C53XX, item 3.c). It is the same threshold type as General Directive (4) (min_mif_normal_landing: 2) and uses the key 'min_mif_previous_dual_contact'. Note the wording differs between 186 ('permitted for SOLO') and 188 ('allowed for SOLO') — preserved verbatim.

special_instructions.verbatim: (1) IP maintains the responsibility for clearing and remaining within the assigned area.

(2) In Sections I45ΧΧ and I46ΧΧ (IFR Navigations) an IFR Navigation and an instrument approach procedure to a strange airfield will be executed at least once for each SP, via ATS Routes or Approach to Approach.
maneuvers: Instrument approach procedure to a strange airfield

special_instructions.verbatim: (3) In addition, in Units I45XX and I46XX a mission may be flown to specific Italian airfields (such as Lecce, Sigonella etc) and Cyprus. Restrictions and Directives derived from BD 3-1/HATC apply in these missions (i.e. fuel minima, weather restrictions, fly over water rules etc). On these airports refueling may be omitted when not necessary, given that the fuel minima/restrictions are met.
(4) Prerequisites of I4701 (Night IFR Navigation) are I4501 and I3601 in night conditions. Training event of I4701 will be completed before I4603.
(5) In case an SP lands in a foreign airport, the corresponding performance code for landing becomes "2".

(6) SPs will fly at least one IFR navigation mission, with two External Fuel Tanks (EFTs), for better familiarization with A/C flying characteristics. This requirement can be filled also in VFR Navigation.

(7) Instrument mission table. DUAL / SOLO — INSTRUMENTS CATEGORY / SECTION / SORTIES / HOURS: BASIC INSTRUMENTS I41ΧΧ 2 2,6 | ADVANCED INSTRUMENTS I42ΧΧ 2 2,6 | ADVANCED INSTRUMENTS I43ΧΧ 2 2,6 | CHECK RIDE I4490 1 1,4 | IFR NAVIGATION I45ΧΧ 2 2,6 | IFR NAVIGATION I46ΧΧ 3 3,9 | NIGHT IFR NAVIGATION I4701 1 1,4 | FINAL CHECK RIDE I4890 1 1,3 | TOTAL 14 18,4

No I3101 section exists in this document (search returned 0 hits); the Instrument category starts at I41ΧΧ. I3201 and I3601 appear only as prerequisites (simulator units, outside this category).

special_instructions.verbatim: (7) SP has to execute at least six instrument approaches throughout the Formation Category (3 as Leader and 3 as Wingman). If possible, CLOSED GCA can be executed instead of an instrument approach.

(4) Minimum execution altitude for formation maneuvers in dual flights is set at 2.000' AGL, except the extended trail that is 6.000' AGL. For the SOLO flights practicing maneuvers will be executed above 5.000' AGL.

(5) Minimum execution altitude for tactical formation maneuvers of the F43XX Section, is set at 3.000' AGL, whereas the altitude of the F45XX Section is lower (1000 -3000 ft AGL). Tactical Formation SOLO flight will be executed above 5.000' AGL.

(3) First SOLO flight of the F43XX section can be executed at F4301 and will be implemented the same or next day of the last dual formation flight. In this sortie SP will execute interval T/O as Leader from the center of the RWY. The next SOLO flight of the F43XX Section will be executed the maximum within four (4) calendar days from the last dual formation flight. The SOLO flight of the F45XX Section can be executed the same or next day of the last dual formation flight.

(8) Formation mission table: TWO SHIP FORMATION F41ΧΧ 4 4,8 / TWO SHIP FORMATION F42ΧΧ 4 4,8 / TWO SHIP FORMATION F43ΧΧ 4 4,8 2 2,4 / TACTICAL FORMATION F44ΧΧ 4 4,8 / TACTICAL FORMATION F45ΧΧ 2 2,4 1 1,2 / FINAL CHECKRIDE F4790 1 1,3 / ΣΥΝΟΛΟ 19 22,9 3 3,6
1. Special Requirements: In this Section T/O will be Interval, except for two flights in which IP will demonstrate Formation T/O (as No1 and No2).

(2) The following maneuvers ARE PROHIBITED to be executed in SOLO flights: (a) T/O as Wingman. (b) Echelon turns as Wingman. (c) Close trail as Wingman. (d) Εextended trail as Wingman. (e) Cross Turns.
(1) Flight time will be equally distributed as a Leader and Wingman, depending on fuel and time availability.
(6) Interval T/O, either as Leader or as Wingman, is not required to be demonstrated by IP.
3. SP will perform (both as leader and wingman) an instrument approach VOR/DME or TACAN with or without the GCA. Closed GCA may be executed instead.
RESTRICTIONS: 3. The first SOLO flight can be executed at the F4501, adhering to BD 3-1/HATC restrictions.

flags: Section keys follow the MIF t6a.json unit ranges (F4101-04, F4201-04, F4301-06, F4401-04, F4501-03, F4690); the syllabus Program Analysis headers print them as F41ΧΧ / F42ΧΧ / F43ΧΧ / F44ΧΧ / F45ΧΧ (Greek capital chi) and F4690.

Every Program Analysis maneuver in the Formation category sits under a 'Leader' or 'Wingman' sub-heading; the role is appended to 'name' (e.g. 'Formation approach (Leader)') because most maneuvers appear twice per section. 'verbatim' keeps the printed bullet exactly, without the role.

Numbers are printed in a right-hand column (x≈397-439) aligned row-by-row with the bullets; alignment was resolved from PyMuPDF word coordinates, not from linear text extraction (linear extraction mis-groups them, e.g. 'Pitch out / Rejoin(4)(5)').
per='section' for all entries: the Program Analysis numbers are totals for the whole Training Section (4-6 sorties). No Formation text defines a per-sortie minimum.
F4301-06 p.214 prints 'Close Trail - Fighting Wing. (2) - (2)' — two numbers on one bullet (most plausibly Close Trail (2) and Fighting Wing (2)). Recorded as min_number 2; verbatim preserved.
'Close Trail - Fighting Wing' spans two MIF rows (sn 22 'Close Trail' and sn 18 'Route / Fighting Wing'); mapped to sn 22.
'Pitch out / Rejoin (5)' (Wingman, F41XX/F42XX/F43XX) has no single MIF row: it straddles sn 16 'Pitch Out / Spacing', sn 9 'Turning Rejoin' and sn 10 'Straight Ahead Rejoin'. mif_sn=null.
Hook / Cross / Check turns all map to the single MIF row sn 28 'Cross/ Hook/ Shackle/ Check turns'; four distinct Program Analysis bullets share it.

special_instructions.verbatim: (1) Low Level Navigation sorties can be flown after C5201.
(2) Flight time as lead or wingman will be divided equal in every sortie.
(3) All Medium Level Navigation sorties will be flown equal or above MSA of the legs.
(4) IP will demonstrate one leg at 500΄ AGL in N43XX and N45XX Section.
(5) VFR Navigation sorties must have at least 5 legs with 10 to 30 NM distance per leg.

(6) If conditions permit, SP could execute navigation sorties and land at strange airfield as long as he/she flies back on the same day (Out and Back), as soon as restrictions and minimums are not violated IAW B.O. 3-1/ATC (minimum fuels, weather minima, training flight restrictions above Ground – Sea, etc.).
(7) SP will occupy front seat in all navigation sorties.

(8) VFR Navigation Table. | DUAL SOLO | NAVIGATION CATEGORY / SECTION / SORTIES HOURS SORTIES HOURS | MEDIUM LEVEL VFR NAVIGATION Ν41ΧΧ 2 2,2 | LOW LEVEL VFR NAVIGATION Ν42ΧΧ 2 2,2 | LOW LEVEL VFR NAVIGATION Ν43ΧΧ 2 2,2 | LOW LEVEL VFR NAVIGATION (FORMATION) Ν44ΧΧ 3 3,3 | LOW LEVEL VFR NAVIGATION (FORMATION) Ν45ΧΧ 3 3,3 | FINAL CHECKRIDE Ν4690 1 1,2 | TOTAL 13 14,4

(9) In the program analysis of Training Units (“Analytical description of Section exercise”) and next to each maneuver, in parenthesis, the MINIMUM NUMBER of maneuvers that SP must practice until the end of a Training Section, appear. In case that the minimum number is not achieved SP will be granted an extra sortie or he/she will cover the required items in the next Section according to Squadron Commander’s judgment.

(10) Whenever there is no minimum number next to a maneuver in the Program Analysis, but the MIF for this maneuver is bigger in this Training Section than the previous one, then the maneuver should be practiced as much as required for the MIF to be achieved.

flags: ΚΕΝΟ ΠΑΡΕΝΘΕΣΕΩΝ: σΕ ΚΑΜΙΑ από τις 6 ενότητες της κατηγορίας VFR Navigation (σελ. PDF 225-231) ΔΕΝ υπάρχει αριθμός σε παρένθεση δίπλα σε ελιγμό στο «ANALYTICAL DESCRIPTION OF SECTION EXERCISES». Ολοκληρωμένος έλεγχος κάθε bullet: μηδέν αριθμητικές ενδείξεις. Όλα τα maneuver entries που καταγράφηκαν προέρχονται αποκλειστικά από το τμήμα «SPECIAL DIRECTIVES – AIDS» της ίδιας ενότητας, όπου τυπώνεται ρητός αριθμός εκτελέσεων («one… once» / «one… at least in one sortie»).

ΥΠΟ-ΚΑΤΗΓΟΡΙΑ ΕΓΓΡΑΦΩΝ — ΥΠΟ ΣΥΝΘΗΚΗ: τα 3 entries «Instrument Approach during RTB» (N4101-02, N4201-02, N4301-02) εισάγονται στο πρωτότυπο με τον όρο «If it is feasible». Ο αριθμός («one instrument approach … at least in one sortie») είναι τυπωμένος, αλλά Η ΑΠΑΙΤΗΣΗ ΔΕΝ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΑΠΟΛΥΤΗ — να μην αντιμετωπιστεί ως ακλόνητο minimum. Η συνθήκη διατηρείται αυτούσια στο verbatim.

ΔΕΝ ΚΑΤΑΓΡΑΦΗΚΕ (χωρίς τυπωμένο αριθμό): N4690 σελ.231 «3. During RTB, SP will execute an instrument approach, if it is possible.» — χρησιμοποιεί άρθρο («an»), όχι αριθμητικό προσδιορισμό «one» όπως οι N41XX/N42XX/N43XX, και είναι επίσης υπό συνθήκη. Αν η εφαρμογή το θέλει ως min_number=1, απαιτείται απόφαση χρήστη.

ΔΕΝ ΚΑΤΑΓΡΑΦΗΚΕ (μέγιστο, όχι ελάχιστο, και απαιτεί υπολογισμό): οι ενότητες N4201-02 (σελ.226 παρ.4), N4301-02 (σελ.227 παρ.3), N4501-03 (σελ.229 παρ.4) ορίζουν: «At briefing, IP will determine legs in which SP can use GPS. Those legs will not exceed half of total legs and should/will be flown above sea.» (κλάσμα «half», όχι ακέραιος αριθμός εκτελέσεων). Η ίδια οδηγία υπάρχει και στην N4401-03 (σελ.228 παρ.3) και σε συντομότερη μορφή στην N4690 (σελ.231 παρ.4).

SRN-01 vs SRN-1: στις ενότητες (σελ.227, 229) ο κωδικός τυπώνεται «SRN-01», ενώ στον πίνακα κωδικών Special Requirements (σελ.103) ως «SRN-1 Οne leg in a Navigation sortie will be flown at 500’ AGL» (με ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΟ κεφαλαίο Ομικρόν U+039F στο «Οne» — προσοχή σε string matching).

MIF sn 26 «Special Requirements» (D:\\FDMS\\data\\mif\\t6a.json, vfr_navigation_t6a): έχει τιμή σε ΔΥΟ στήλες — N4301-02 = «E» και N4501-03 = «1» — δηλαδή αμφότερες οι ενότητες με τυπωμένο SRN-01 έχουν οριζόμενο MIF. Δεν υπάρχει ασυμφωνία κάλυψης· εκκρεμεί μόνο ότι ο κώδικας «E» δεν ορίζεται πουθενά στο PDF (η παρ.7a σελ.24 ορίζει 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 και D). Διατηρήθηκε mif_sn=26 και για τις δύο ενότητες.

ΑΜΦΙΣΗΜΙΑ MIF ROW: ο πίνακας vfr_navigation_t6a έχει ΔΥΟ γραμμές με ταυτόσημο όνομα «Instrument Procedures» (sn 15 και sn 20). Επιλέχθηκε mif_sn=15 γιατί στις στήλες N4101-02/N4201-02/N4301-02 μόνο το sn 15 έχει τιμή («*») ενώ το sn 20 είναι κενό. Το έγγραφο ΔΕΝ διαφοροποιεί τις δύο γραμμές.

ΚΛΕΙΔΙΑ ΕΝΟΤΗΤΩΝ: χρησιμοποιήθηκαν οι κωδικοί στηλών του MIF (N4101-02 κ.λπ., ΛΑΤΙΝΙΚΟ N). Στο PDF οι επικεφαλίδες των ενοτήτων και ο πίνακας (8) τυπώνονται με ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΑ γράμματα («Ν41ΧΧ»: U+039D + U+03A7), ενώ μέσα στο κείμενο των οδηγιών χρησιμοποιείται ΛΑΤΙΝΙΚΟ «N43XX». Το verbatim διατηρεί τους χαρακτήρες του πρωτοτύπου.
Το σύμβολο ποδιών στο «500΄ AGL» είναι U+0384 (GREEK TONOS), ΟΧΙ απόστροφος/prime — διατηρήθηκε αυτούσιο. Στη σελ.103 (ορισμός SRN-1) τυπώνεται διαφορετικά: «500’ AGL» (U+2019).

ΕΛΑΧΙΣΤΗ ΑΣΑΦΕΙΑ ΔΙΑΤΥΠΩΣΗΣ: στην N4301-02 γράφεται «IP will demonstrate» ενώ στην N4501-03 «IP will practice» (και στην κατηγοριακή οδηγία (4) «IP will demonstrate» και για τις δύο). Η έννοια του ποιος εκτελεί (IP και όχι SP) διατηρείται αυτούσια — δεν πρόκειται για εκτέλεση του μαθητή.

ΣΕΛΙΔΕΣ ΧΩΡΙΣ ΚΕΙΜΕΝΟ: οι PDF σελίδες 224 (τυπ. -216-) και 232 (τυπ. -224-) είναι κενές (0 chars με PyMuPDF και με το MCP extractor) — σελίδες διαχωρισμού. ΔΕΝ κατέστη δυνατόν να επαληθευτεί οπτικά (το render_pdf_page απέτυχε: λείπει το native canvas binding), όμως η ροή των τυπωμένων αριθμών σελίδας (-215- → -217-) και η συνέχεια των ενοτήτων δεν αφήνει κενό περιεχομένου.
Η ενότητα N4501-03 ξεκινά στη σελ. PDF 229 και τα RESTRICTIONS/FUEL CONSUMPTION της συνεχίζουν στη σελ. 230.

ΤΟ ΠΕΔΙΟ numbers ΤΗΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΑΣ (8): οι ώρες τυπώνονται με ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗ υποδιαστολή («2,2») και αποδόθηκαν ως δεκαδικοί με τελεία (2.2). Καμία στήλη SOLO δεν έχει τιμή (όλες οι εξόδοι της κατηγορίας είναι DUAL). Τα 13/14,4 είναι ΤΥΠΩΜΕΝΑ (TOTAL), δεν υπολογίστηκαν.

ΟΙ ΦΡΑΣΕΙΣ (9) και (10) της σελ. PDF 164 (τυπ. -156-) ΔΕΝ ανήκουν στις Special Instructions της κατηγορίας — είναι γενικοί κανόνες του σταδίου (scope=phase) και περιλήφθηκαν γιατί εξηγούν το κενό παρενθέσεων σε αυτή την κατηγορία (κανόνας 10: όπου δεν υπάρχει αριθμός, ο ελιγμός εκτελείται όσες φορές χρειάζεται για να επιτευχθεί το MIF).
